topic: Quantum Superposition and the Mystery of States

sections.title: The Classical vs. Quantum Prelude
lecture_lines: Classical bits are strictly zero or one.
Quantum qubits exist in multiple configurations simultaneously.
Think of a spinning, blurred coin.
It represents both states at once.
Observation forces a single definite result.
animations: Show two balls [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg] representing classical states, 0 and 1.
Introduce a quantum state |ψ⟩ as a vector.
Transition classical states [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg] to quantum basis states |0⟩ and |1⟩.

sections.title: Defining Superposition via Linear Combination
lecture_lines: We define superposition as a linear combination.
The state vector is ψ equals alpha |0> plus beta |1>.
Alpha and beta are complex probability amplitudes.
The sum of squares must equal one.
Visually, this maps to the Bloch sphere surface.
animations: Show state |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ equation using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] to represent the state space.
Animate weights α and β scaling state vectors.
Visualize superposition as a combined vector in Hilbert space using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] to define the Bloch sphere mapping.

sections.title: The Measurement Problem and Collapse
lecture_lines: Measurement forces the wave function to collapse.
The probability depends on the squared amplitudes.
The vector snaps to a basis pole.
animations: Represent state |ψ⟩ as a superposition of possibilities.
Visualize an observer using an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/eye.svg] collapsing |ψ⟩ to |0⟩ or |1⟩.
Show resulting probabilistic outcome of measurement using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sensor.svg].

sections.title: Application: The Power of Parallelism
lecture_lines: Superposition grants massive parallel processing potential.
Quantum computers evaluate many paths simultaneously.
This creates a powerful quantum advantage.
animations: Visualize simultaneous calculation across multiple states using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/processor.svg].
Compare classical bit operation with qubit state operation using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
Illustrate exponential speedup for a specific problem using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/processor.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Review
lecture_lines: Superposition reflects a state of multiple possibilities.
Observation serves as our physical bridge.
Probability becomes certainty through the measurement process.
animations: Summarize superposition and linear combination concepts using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microscope.svg].
